referer.description: The origin from which the visit was performed

date.description: The date in which the visit was performed

userAgent.description: The user agent from which the visit was performed

potentialBot.description: Tells if Shlink thinks this visit comes potentially from a bot or crawler

id.description: This visit's own stable identity, which is never reused

visitedUrl.description: The full URL which was visited, including the query string

deviceType.description: The device class assigned to this visit. Anything not positively recognized as mobile, tablet or desktop is reported as other, never as desktop. Null for visits captured before device classification existed

deviceTypeDetail.description: The underlying device type the other class stands for, or an explicit unknown marker where it could not be determined. Null when deviceType is not other
